body:
**Update :**

I want to borrow $3000 from the [Diversification Fund](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/13201-edg-diversification-fund-funds-recoup-proposal) for the proposal. I'll pay it back right after we set up the Edgeverse DAO platform. This approach is more favorable given our present market conditions.

**The Diversification Fund**

Today's Value: $9,490


![image](https://assets.commonwealth.im/27b642ce-724f-41a5-ae5b-ea364f044824.png)


Multichain Portfolio: https://etherscan.io/address/0x29a1e8eBeF0523a15fD3c2fdb68686c7c2D7b278#multichain-portfolio

Why do you want to touch this fund, it had/has different purpose. Use worthless $EDG token and liquidate on the market. Or as always you can do not touch treasury funds and do nothing, in hope that one day price of $EDG will go up..

This is a retired fund it does not have other purposes. Ironic of you to say that we are just hoping in EDG price should increase when this proposal's whole plan is to increase the value.
I suggest you read in to the situation and the intent before making such comments.

Proposed solution: Liquidate the $3000 equivalent of ETH holdings from the [Diversification Fund A](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/13201-edg-diversification-fund-funds-recoup-proposal).

- Current ETH holdings of Diversification Fund A: **0.9221 ETH (~3126.8411 USD at the time of posting)**
- The requested amount for the legal entity registration (MiDAO bootstrap package): 3000 USD equivalent



Thus we will encode a remark-based referendum for this proposal which upon community approval will mandate the liquidation of ETH holdings from the 'Diversification Fund A' to purchase the MiDAO bootstrap package intended for the legal entity registration of the **Edgeverse Sub-DAO**.
{ETH holdings: 0.0851 ETH on Ethereum, 0.3953 ETH on BSC, 0.014 ETH on Optimism and 0.4277 ETH on Arbitrum}


This is an add-on Referendum(1.5) to the existing series of 4 referenda mentioned here: 
[https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/14922-diversigen-evolutionary-fund-diversification-initiative?comment=72778](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/14922-diversigen-evolutionary-fund-diversification-initiative?comment=72778)

This referendum is intended to go live between 'Referendum 1' and 'Referendum 2'. The outcomes of the Referendum(1.5) do not affect the other four Referenda structurally.

New proposed strategy with the legal entity registration(s) to save costs and time: 

https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/25104-new-path-for-the-legal-entity-registrations-by-bharathcoorg
You've overlooked EDG. Why don't you register Edgeware?
